lead.headline: COP31 collapses with no deal as talks run longest ever
lead.summary: The UN climate summit in Antalya ended on Sunday with no agreement after the EU and others rejected a final draft that made no mention of fossil fuels. Talks ran two days past their deadline, the longest COP in history. UN chief António Guterres said he was “deeply disappointed”, and attention now turns to COP32 in Addis Ababa.

stories.headline: Mexico seizes 'El Chapo Isidro', one of the FBI's most wanted
stories.summary: Mexican special forces captured Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as 'El Chapo Isidro', in a raid in Sinaloa. Eleven people died in the gun battle, including four soldiers. He was one of the FBI's ten most wanted fugitives, with a $5m reward on his head.

stories.headline: Iran strikes Bahrain industrial site
stories.summary: An Iranian projectile hit an industrial facility in Bahrain and wounded two people, while Bahraini air defences intercepted other attacks. Bahrain is home to the US Navy's Fifth Fleet.

stories.headline: Candy factory fire in Cikande kills 3, 36 missing
stories.summary: A fire swept through the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia candy factory in Cikande, Banten, maker of Milkita, killing three people. Thirty-six were still missing on Sunday as the search went on. The blaze began on Saturday afternoon; 15 people escaped and four were hurt.

stories.headline: Russian drone hits apartment block near Kyiv
stories.summary: A Russian drone struck a five-storey apartment block in Dymer, near Kyiv, on Sunday, killing two people and injuring four. Fourteen people were still missing under the rubble.

stories.headline: Alcaraz beats Zverev to win first ATP Finals title
stories.summary: Carlos Alcaraz defeated world No. 1 Alexander Zverev 6-2, 7-6(7) in Turin on Sunday to claim his first ATP Finals title and a record champion's prize of $5,171,000. Zverev still finishes the year as world No. 1.
